text: あいての　ＰＰが　へりやすくなる

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい added to a verb means it happens easily. へりやすく = 'easily going down'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: A describing word ending in い changes to く before なる to say 'becomes that way'. へりやすくなる = 'comes to go down easily'.
